result.stdout:
USAGE:
    artisanlogbook [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    artisanlogbook init
    artisanlogbook import
    artisanlogbook import ArtisanLogbook_Core.lua
    artisanlogbook import --verbose
    artisanlogbook import ArtisanLogbook_Core.lua --verbose

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    init      Interactively configure World of Warcraft installation roots (no  
              import)                                                           
    import    Import snapshots with concise change summaries; use --verbose for 
              complete diagnostics                                              
    status    Show read-only history counts across all game contexts            
    erase     Permanently delete the history database so SavedVariables can be  
              reimported                                                        
    serve     Run the Companion host and local HTTP API until stopped (no       
              automatic imports yet)

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Import snapshots with concise change summaries; use --verbose for complete 
diagnostics.

USAGE:
    artisanlogbook import [SOURCE-FILE] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    artisanlogbook import
    artisanlogbook import ArtisanLogbook_Core.lua
    artisanlogbook import --verbose
    artisanlogbook import ArtisanLogbook_Core.lua --verbose
    artisanlogbook import ArtisanLogbook_Core.lua --database history.duckdb

ARGUMENTS:
    [SOURCE-FILE]    Explicit snapshot; omit to discover all configured         
                     ArtisanLogbook_Core.lua ledgers. Sources are never modified

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                            
    -v, --version            Prints version information                         
        --database <PATH>    Override the shared history database path (relative
                             to the working directory)                          
        --verbose            Show full paths, detailed import counts, and all   
                             diagnostics, including unchanged historical        
                             warnings

USAGE:
    artisanlogbook erase [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    artisanlogbook erase
    artisanlogbook erase --yes
    artisanlogbook erase --database history.duckdb --yes

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                            
    -v, --version            Prints version information                         
        --database <PATH>    Override the shared history database path (relative
                             to the working directory)                          
    -y, --yes                Erase without asking for confirmation (required    
                             when not running interactively)
